content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the KSRLPS Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 15-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of KSRLPS to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for KSRLPS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the KSRLPS Various Positions under SVEP and Non-Farm Livelihoods recruitment is 15 August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in KSRLPS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies announced for various positions under SVEP and Non-Farm Livelihoods by the Karnataka State Rural Livelihood Promotion Society (KSRLPS) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the KSRLPS posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit for all the posts is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 45 years. Specific age relaxation details are not provided in the current data.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for KSRLPS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this KSRLPS recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any application charges.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for KSRLPS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for the KSRLPS Recruitment 2026 primarily involves an Online Application. Further stages, if any, would be detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for Block Program Officer – SVEP?
faq.answer: For the Block Program Officer – SVEP post, candidates need to be Post Graduate / Graduate in any subject with Mathematics till class 10. A background in Management, Commerce, or Engineering is preferred, along with 2 years of experience in the non-farm livelihoods sector.

faq.question: Q7. Can candidates from outside Karnataka apply for KSRLPS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification specifies that applications are invited from eligible candidates in Karnataka. It is advisable to check the official notification for detailed eligibility regarding domicile.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for the Taluk Program Manager post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Taluk Program Manager post has not been disclosed in the provided information. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for any updates on salary details.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is contractual. This means the employment will be for a fixed period as per the terms and conditions of the KSRLPS.
